name: Subex Ltd
title: Subex Ltd - 532348 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Subex Q4FY26 revenue rose only 3% QoQ to INR 72.96 cr with no numeric FY27 guidance; management leans on 24% order intake growth and a Middle East exposure it calls manageable.

triggers.label: Order intake +24% in FY26
triggers.quote: Our order intake grew 24%. We released new products.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue +3% QoQ to INR 72.96 cr
triggers.quote: The revenue for the quarter stood at INR 72.96 crores as against INR 70.79 crores for the previous quarter.

triggers.label: Middle East risk to new decisions
triggers.quote: in terms of new decisions or new purchase decisions, that's where we see a slight risk of customers delaying decisions.

guidance.quote: I would say that as team as everyone here, we are actually very bullish right now.

red_flags.label: No numeric FY27 guidance; evasive on milestone payments
red_flags.quote: I think that might be challenging only because, contractually, we are bound by some, you confidentiality issues with the customers.

red_flags.label: Receivables from exited sectorial contract in litigation
red_flags.quote: we have decided to take a legal route. So that's where we will go, down the legal path

red_flags.label: Management holds shares only via ESOPs; no promoter
red_flags.quote: the way management holds stocks today is through ESOPs.

evasions.quote: I'm a little reluctant to tell you that because it's competition sensitive on this call.
contractually, we are bound by some, you confidentiality issues with the customers.
Middle East, no doubt, will have some impact.
